Canvas 2D compositing strings. Sole declaration site — consumers import members from this frozen map rather than re-declaring the literals (zero-hardcoding rule).

CHANNEL_RED / CHANNEL_CYAN are channel-isolation mask inks, not theme colors: filling an image's copy with them under multiply keeps only that RGB channel so offset 'lighter' composites re-add it as a chromatic ghost — the mechanism behind real analog-style RGB split.
